backgrounds: A single, unchanging set for the entire episode: a bright, upscale nail/foot-spa salon rendered in soft stop-motion style. lighting_notes: Even, soft, diffused lighting typical of a bright indoor salon/spa — no harsh shadows or dramatic contrast. Lighting stays constant throughout since it's one continuous scene, reinforcing the low-key, mundane 'waiting room' mood. Shallow focus (background softly blurred, subjects sharp) is the main visual/lighting technique used to direct attention, rather than any lighting changes.
visual_complexity_notes: The set is minimal and static: one continuous, low-clutter salon environment reused for the whole episode, with soft-focus background elements (other patrons, mirrors, product shelves) kept deliberately blurry and secondary. This is a stylized, character-focused staging choice — the simplicity of the backdrop and the shallow depth of field push all visual attention onto the two leads' faces, expressions, and small hand props (phone, drink), which is where the comedic beats live.
